Definition: of Hebrew origin (H2074); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of Palestine:--Zabulon.
BiblicalUsage: Zabulon is the land of Zebulun, named in the New Testament where prophecy meets fulfilment. In Matthew 4:13 Jesus leaves Nazareth and dwells in Capernaum, "which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim," and Matthew 4:15 quotes Isaiah, "The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea." Revelation 7:8 seals twelve thousand of the tribe of Zabulon among the servants of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Matthew put Zabulon in the story on purpose. I hold that Jesus choosing to live in the borders of Zabulon, as Matthew 4:13 says, is Isaiah's prophecy coming true in a real place, and that the sealed tribe in Revelation 7:8 shows God has not forgotten the north.
